verdict.rationale: The skills CLI exposes much of what the skills.sh site does programmatically: keyword and org search (`skills find`), listing a repo's skills without installing, install, list, update, remove and init. The probe confirms it runs keylessly and switches to non-interactive mode when driven by an agent. However, no REST API is documented, and a community user explicitly asks skills.sh to 'make a rest API', so leaderboard and ranking data on the website has no evidenced programmatic equivalent. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API for skills.sh, programmatic access to leaderboard and install-count data, and an explicit UI-to-API parity statement.
